prompt_inputs.goal: Marathon preparation with carbohydrate loading for high-intensity endurance training

solution_criteria: Meal plan contains 4-5 meals/snacks optimized for energy density and sustained fuel delivery
Carbohydrates comprise 60-70% of total calories with emphasis on complex carbs and natural sugars
Total daily caloric intake aligns with elevated endurance athlete requirements (approximately 3,000-3,500 calories)
Plan is presented in compact, concise format suitable for 1-day consumption
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a high-intensity endurance athlete (marathon runner) who requires elevated calorie intake and carbohydrate loading, verifying the meal plan prioritizes energy density and sustained fuel

prompt_inputs.goal: Muscle building during bulk phase with emphasis on protein distribution

solution_criteria: Meal plan contains exactly 4-5 meals distributed throughout the day
Each meal contains 30-40g of protein with at least 3 meals meeting this target
Total daily calories create a surplus of 300-500 calories above maintenance for muscle building
Plan is presented in compact, easy-to-read format suitable for a single day
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a strength/power athlete (weightlifter) during a bulk phase, ensuring the meal plan emphasizes protein distribution across meals and includes strategic caloric surplus for muscle building

prompt_inputs.goal: optimize athletic performance and recovery for basketball

solution_criteria: Meal plan covers all meals for one full day in compact format
All meals are vegetarian with no meat, poultry, or fish
Includes adequate protein and carbohydrates to support basketball performance and recovery
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a sport-specific athlete (basketball player) with dietary restrictions (vegetarian), confirming the meal plan accommodates the restriction while meeting athletic performance nutritional requirements in a compact format
